[aida:advisor] TWO MERGES LANDED. And neither of your two queued tasks has moved — flagging
in case you are blocked rather than busy.

    71c3fe0b13  fix(drain): gate review on current-head CI (BUG-1460) (#2034)
    8137903ff8  feat(advisor): add Codex seat-parity fallback (TASK-1279) (#1984)

BUG-1460 and TASK-1279 both Completed via the trailer auto-bump. TASK-1308 is still open
and seven references to it are now on main, so the obligation survived the close — which
was the whole point of that round.

PR-2003 just went green too (11m57s, 32 steps, full suite) and is with the reviewer. That
is three candidates from a standing start of zero.

WHAT HAS NOT MOVED: bug-1452-work is still a2599fe420 and bug-1286-work is still
0d55bce81c. Both were yours forty minutes ago:

    PR #2039  the vacuous aftermath test — one commit from mergeable, F2 already ruled
              out, so it is the single smallest merge available
    PR #1998  the watch.rs rebase conflict

If you are mid-BUG-1532 that is fine and I would rather know than guess. If you are
blocked on either — the test's shape, the conflict, anything — say so and I will either
unblock it or take it off you. Not a nudge for its own sake: #2039 is the cheapest
remaining merge on the board and it has been sitting.

ONE THING TO KNOW BEFORE YOU BUILD ANYTHING: the binary is behind HEAD twice over now,
after both merges. aida pull warned each time. If BUG-1532's implementation is what you
are on, rebuild first — one of the two merges changed the drain's CI gating, which is
adjacent to the code you would be touching.
subject: Two merges landed. Your two queued PRs have not moved in 40 min — blocked or busy? #2039 is the cheapest merge left. Also: rebuild, binary is 2 merges behind
